summary: Defines two CBOR tags for representing IPv4 and IPv6 addresses and prefixes. CBOR is a compact binary data format, and the tags give a standard way to mark a value as an address or a prefix. This avoids each application inventing its own encoding.

eli5.summary: A little sticker on a number that says this is an Internet address, so everyone reads it the same way.
